title: Algorithmic Collusion Without Deterrence: Auditing the Punishment Mechanism in Q-Learning Pricing Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.21867v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Independent tabular Q-learning agents repricing in a simulated Bertrand duopoly converge to supracompetitive prices, and the seminal evidence attributes this to a learned reward-punishment scheme: undercut your rival and it retaliates, so deviation never pays. This mechanistic reading is what turns high prices into a cartel, and into a regulatory target. We replicate the environment of Calvano et al. (2020) and confirm their impulse-response pattern within co-trained pairs. We then audit the pattern on frozen policies, with learning off, and find that on its own it does not identify a mechanism: the return is over-determined rather than selective. In nine of ten converged pairs (914 of 1,024) a single attractor's basin is the entire state space, so every perturbation returns whatever provoked it, and a forced price increase triggers the same retaliatory pattern as an undercut. translated_title: 无威慑的算法合谋：审计Q学习定价智能体中的惩罚机制
translated_abstract: 独立的表格型Q学习智能体在模拟的伯川德双寡头市场中重新定价时，会收敛到超竞争价格，而开创性的研究证据将此归因于一种学到的“奖励-惩罚”机制：若你削价对抗对手，对手就会报复，因此偏离定价永远不划算。正是这种机制性解读，将高价格转变为卡特尔行为，并使其成为监管目标。我们复现了Calvano等人（2020）的环境，并确认了他们在共同训练智能体对中的脉冲响应模式。随后我们在冻结策略上审计这一模式——即关闭学习过程——发现该模式本身并不能识别出这一机制：回报是过度决定的，而非选择性的。在十个收敛的智能体对中的九个（1024次中的914次）里，单一吸引子的吸引盆覆盖了整个状态空间，因此任何扰动都会返回，无论其起因是什么，而且强制提价会触发与削价完全相同的报复模式。共同训练真正产生的，是一个狭窄的、仅针对特定智能体对的吸引盆……
tldr: 该研究审计了Q学习定价智能体的“惩罚机制”，发现在关闭学习后脉冲响应模式无法证明威慑机制的存在——超竞争价格可能源于覆盖整个状态空间的单一吸引子（过度决定），而非选择性的报复性惩罚。
en_tdlr: Auditing frozen Q-learning pricing agents reveals that the impulse-response pattern does not by itself demonstrate a deterrence mechanism: supracompetitive prices may arise from an over-determined single attractor spanning the entire state space rather than selective retaliation against undercuts.
